run_scenario_with_environment: run a Scenario in the Environment by calling env.run(scenario) to start the event loop and wait for completion
schedule_events_in_environment: schedule future events in the Environment by calling env.schedule(events) to add them to the event queue
register_apps_to_environment: register App instances to the Environment by calling env.register_apps(apps) to initialize and connect them to protocols
get_environment_state: get the current state of the Environment as a dict by calling env.get_state() with apps, event log, and queue data
process_event_in_environment: process an AbstractEvent in the Environment by calling env.process_event(event) to execute it and return successor events
